applicability.reason: RedactGuard has critical Android document-protection journeys and a cross-process Local AI boundary whose complete outcomes require E2E evidence, while emulator and physical-device evidence support materially different claims.

target_environments.description: A built RedactGuard APK installed on a supported Android device and exercised through production app surfaces, Android document APIs and process-local privacy behavior.
material_dimensions: built APK install and Android process lifecycle
production Compose UI and Android framework behavior
text/PDF ingestion review redaction export and reopen behavior

target_environments.description: RedactGuard and the Local AI Harness installed as exact same-signer APKs on a physical Android target, with the Consumer SDK/Binder boundary and real Harness-owned runtime/model path active.
material_dimensions: exact RedactGuard APK source revision signer and Consumer SDK version
exact Harness APK source revision signer preset and capability identity
real Consumer SDK Binder and cross-process lifecycle
real model runtime device ABI and Android process behavior

execution_environments.artifact_surface: built RedactGuard debug APK plus AndroidTest APK using production Compose/document/redaction/export code and a deterministic AnalysisRuntimePort response
known_gaps: Local AI Harness APK Consumer SDK Binder native runtime and GGUF/model execution are not present
emulator hardware and framework implementation do not establish physical OEM/device behavior
physical-device accessibility performance thermal and resource behavior are not established

execution_environments.platform: GitHub-hosted Linux + Android API 35 Google APIs x86_64 emulator
execution_environments.artifact_surface: separately built and installed same-signer Harness and RedactGuard APKs using the real Consumer SDK, Android Binder Service, Harness Control Plane, activation/residency and RuntimeOrchestrator; only GGUF/native execution is deterministic
known_gaps: x86_64 emulator does not execute the production arm64-v8a llama.cpp/JNI backend
real GGUF bytes, model-load cost, physical memory, thermal and OEM behavior remain physical-device evidence
the Harness emulator ModelStore mirrors production inventory semantics by returning present entries as verified=false and deferring integrity verification to RuntimeOrchestrator prepare

execution_environments.artifact_surface: exact RedactGuard and Local AI Harness APKs installed with signer/source/preset identity, real Consumer SDK/Binder/runtime path, synthetic fixtures and bounded operator-attested product checkpoints
known_gaps: one representative physical device does not establish every supported OEM/API/device combination
operator attestations are required for SAF review recovery export and persistence checkpoints
performance thermal accessibility and protected-release claims require their own explicit protocols when asserted

critical_journeys.claim: User can paste text, choose protection, run local analysis, review each finding, redact or ignore it, and reach a valid export outcome without exposing sensitive values by default.
residual_gaps: the two-APK emulator proves the real cross-process Consumer path but not production ARM64 JNI/GGUF execution
physical Android OEM/accessibility behavior is not established by the emulator

critical_journeys.claim: User can import a text PDF, choose protection, analyze locally, review findings, export the redacted PDF and reopen the output with the expected redactions.
residual_gaps: the PDF journey still uses deterministic AnalysisRuntimePort behavior rather than the two-APK Harness path
physical document-provider/OEM behavior outside the emulator remains representative-device evidence

critical_journeys.claim: When local AI is unavailable the user sees an actionable state, and after the Host becomes available or restarts the real Consumer/Binder path reconnects and analysis reaches a valid review state without reinstalling RedactGuard or exposing partial findings.
residual_gaps: production ARM64 native/model/resource recovery remains physical-device evidence

critical_journeys.claim: After RedactGuard starts a Harness-backed analysis, sending the app to Android Home and returning does not implicitly cancel or duplicate the accepted work: the same process-local AnalysisJobId remains authoritative and the user returns to the active or completed analysis state.
residual_gaps: x86_64 emulator evidence does not establish ARM64 JNI/GGUF model residency or decode continuity
Samsung and other OEM background scheduling, memory pressure, thermal behavior and process reclamation require representative physical evidence
true Harness process death remains a truthful interruption and is not claimed as transparent native continuation

critical_journeys.claim: RedactGuard discovers a separately installed same-signer Harness, crosses the real Consumer SDK/Binder boundary, resolves assignment/preset, activates against production-shaped model inventory, prepares and generates through Harness-owned runtime orchestration, and remains recoverable across Host absence or restart.
residual_gaps: production ARM64 JNI/llama.cpp and real GGUF byte execution remain the physical two-APK confirmation
physical memory thermal and OEM lifecycle behavior remain REAL_ENVIRONMENT
